screens.penny: Hi, {name}! Let's look closely at needs today.

cards.caption: Food, water, a home and clothes are needs.
Needs keep our bodies safe and healthy.

screens.prompt: Put each picture in the right basket.
screens.pennyHint: Ask yourself: do we need it to stay healthy, {name}?
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Look again. Does a body need it to stay well?
screens.doneMessage: All sorted, {name}! Food and a home are needs. The rest is extra.

screens.prompt: One of these keeps you healthy. Which one?
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Soap washes germs away. Staying healthy is a need.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Sweets are a fun extra. Soap keeps you healthy.
screens.retryIntro: Here's that one again, {name}. Which keeps you well?

screens.story: Yusuf has 8 coins. Bread costs 5 coins. A game costs 8 coins.

options.label: The bread
options.outcome: Yusuf buys bread. His family has food tonight, and 3 coins left.

options.label: The game
options.outcome: The game looks fun. But there is nothing for dinner.

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Food is a need. Needs go before wants.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! A game is a fun extra. Yusuf's family needs food.

screens.prompt: It's bedtime. Is a warm bed a need or a want?
screens.rightMessage: That's it, {name}! We all need rest to grow and feel well.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Sleep helps our bodies grow. A bed is a need.
screens.retryIntro: One more look, {name}. Do we need rest?

screens.title: Lesson done, {name}!
screens.message: Food, water, a home, clothes and rest. Those are needs.
